notes.title: -75% on Steel Graves: The Battle for Crystals Starts Now !
notes.content:
Hello, commanders and interstellar warriors,

Now’s the perfect time to dive (or dive back) into the universe of Steel Graves—and at a reduced price! During the Sale, enjoy 75% off and experience a unique mix of:
[list]
[*]Fast-paced third-person combat
[*]Thrilling real-time strategy gameplay
[*]Base building on massive multiplayer battlefields
[/list]

🛡️ Humans or Aliens?
Pick your side:
[list]
[*] Defend your territory with the humans’ solid defensive tactics.
[*] Go on the offensive and surprise your enemies with the aliens’ devastating abilities.
[/list]

⛏️ Your goal? The crystals.
Harvest, build, and dominate. Whoever controls the crystals controls the battlefield. But beware—dynamic events can shift the tide of war in an instant!


👉 Ready to join the fight? Join now !

Thank you for your support, and may the best strategist win! 🚀✨

Do not hesitate to give us feedback on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/YE5T9hv6UQ]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,

We are excited to announce the latest hotfix update for Steel Graves, now live on Steam! This patch addresses several bugs reported by our community, improves game stability, and adjusts balance elements to deliver a smoother and more intense combat experience.

Hotfix Highlights:
[list]
[*] Major bug fixes that were affecting gameplay.
[*] Performance optimizations to reduce loading times and enhance responsiveness.
[*] Balance adjustments to make battles more strategic and dynamic.
[*] Visual enhancements and UI tweaks to boost immersion.
[/list]

Grab your controllers and keep the battle alive!

The Steel Graves Team

Do not hesitate to give us feedback on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/YE5T9hv6UQ]Discord[/url]
To not miss anything go to [url=https://twitter.com/AridideProd]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Steel Graves - Early Access
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the Early Access of Steel Graves!

It's a new chapter that begins for our team.
Morality is high and we are committed to making many updates to quickly improve your gaming experience.


[h1]Available in Early Access on Steam ![/h1] 
Genre: Action - Strategy
Developer: Aridide Production
Multiplayer: Yes - Co-op - Split screen

[h1]The battle begins ![/h1] 
Steel Graves is a third-person multiplayer action / strategy game.
The story takes place several years in the future during the great war between humanity and the Aliens from the planet Tartare. To combat the threat, the mega space company NeoTerra is colonizing the planets of the galaxy to plunder their most expensive resource on the market, Orion crystals. These same crystals are the main food and energy of the Tartare Aliens.
The player will take his place during this conflict and will have the choice to don the uniform of Neoterra or play the Aliens !




[h1]Update[/h1]
We rely on your feedback to determine some of the content for future updates. Please feel free to send your comments and requests on the Steel Graves Steam Forum.
You can also easily contact us via Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/4NZCUPd 

The next update will contain the following :
[list] [*]Improved English translation
[*] Fixed bugs
[*] Addition of Steam functions (Invite in the lobby, Join the game, ...)
[*] Improvement of artificial intelligence
[/list]
